author: Odric Vane, cartographer
pages:
Ridge line runs north-east, two bends, then a saddle. Stream at the bottom not on any chart I own. Marked it.

There is a dark opening in the hillside across the valley. The locals call it nothing at all, which in my experience means they are afraid of it.

Went across to look. Old stone around the mouth, cut, not natural. Something has been dragging bones inside. I am a cartographer, not a hero, so I have drawn it from a respectful distance and moved on.
